The Marlin Alliance, Inc. is a digital transformation company that develops technical solutions for automated business processes, governed data, analytics, and cybersecurity. The Junior Power Platform Developer will support a Navy client by developing Microsoft 365 workflows and Power Apps, generating reports, troubleshooting issues, and delivering virtual demonstrations and training.

Responsibilities
Develop and maintain basic Microsoft 365 (M365) Power Automate workflows to support client needs
Assist in the creation and deployment of Power Apps to streamline business processes
Support data analysis by generating and updating reports using the M365 Office suite, including Excel
Troubleshoot simple workflow issues and escalate complex challenges to senior team members
Learn and help maximize the client’s customized M365 Teams environment to execute deliverables
Participate in delivering virtual demos and training sessions for solutions developed
